clue.text: Alan's ignoring peripheral part of speech to study Welsh food?

indicators.note: ignoring the peripheral letters keeps only the inner part of the name Alan

parts.note: a verb is one of the parts of speech
to read a subject is to study it

explanation.surface: Alan skips the outer bits of a speech so he can research Welsh cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ignoring peripheral' strips the end letters of ALAN, leaving LA.
explanation.definitionFit: Laverbread is a traditional Welsh dish of boiled seaweed purée, often fried with oatmeal.

clue.text: Winter sport with several holdalls needed? No joke

indicators.note: no joke here means the jest is taken out of the bags

parts.note: holdalls together are luggage
a gag is a joke

explanation.surface: A ski trip needs lots of bags, and that's no laughing matter.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking GAG out of LUGGAGE leaves the four letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The luge is a Winter Olympic sledging event, ridden feet first on the back.

clue.text: Mostly leave nouvelle cuisine

indicators.note: nouvelle is French for new, signalling the letters are freshly arranged
mostly means all of the word leave except its final letter

explanation.surface: A diner mostly walks away from fussy modern French cooking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mostly' drops the last E from LEAVE; 'nouvelle' rearranges LEAV.
explanation.definitionFit: Veal is a meat served as a dish, an example of cuisine on a menu.

clue.text: Novelist's appended clause wasted

parts.note: a rider is a clause added to a document or bill
haggard means gaunt and wasted-looking

explanation.surface: A writer's added clause has been thrown away for nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is': the novelist is the two pieces together.
explanation.definitionFit: H. Rider Haggard was the Victorian author of King Solomon's Mines and She.

clue.text: Oven gave a buzz at end of procedure

parts.note: to give someone a buzz is to ring them, so gave a buzz is rang

indicators.note: at end of picks the final letter of the word procedure

explanation.surface: The oven timer sounded once the cooking process was finished.
explanation.definitionFit: A range is a large cooking stove with an oven, such as an Aga.

clue.text: Bother if leg's troublesome? It's a miserable existence

parts.note: ado is fuss or bother

indicators.note: troublesome suggests the letters of if leg's are unruly and jumbled

explanation.surface: Is it a nuisance if your leg plays up? Life would be wretched.
explanation.walkthrough: 'troublesome' shuffles the six letters of 'if leg's'; the possessive apostrophe gives no letter. 'It's' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for a wretched, put-upon life comes from the lowly lot of a dog.

clue.text: Excited knight leaves Academy with medal

indicators.note: the knight leaves, so his letter is taken out of the medal

parts.note: gong is slang for a medal or award
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A thrilled knight quits the Academy after receiving a medal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' looks like a verb about quitting the Academy, but it signals the knight's letter coming out of the medal.
explanation.definitionFit: Agog means eagerly excited, waiting with great anticipation.

clue.text: More than one grouse in acres, with veg to munch

indicators.note: to munch is to chew things up, so the letters are mashed into a new order

explanation.surface: A game bird is in the fields, eating vegetables.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to munch' rearranges INACRESVEG. 'grouse' looks like the bird, but here it is a complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: To grouse is to grumble, and a grouse is a complaint, so several are grievances.

clue.text: Wildflower here in India developed best on A road

parts.note: Goa is a state in India

indicators.note: developed means grown into a new form, so the letters of best are rearranged

explanation.surface: This wildflower grows in India, flourishing beside a main road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developed' turns BEST into TSBE. 'on' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Goatsbeard is a meadow wildflower, also called Jack-go-to-bed-at-noon.

clue.text: Relative with horse, retracing favourite canal

parts.note: a gran is a relative, a grandmother
a dun is a horse of dull greyish-brown colour

indicators.note: retracing means going back over, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: the favourite is number one, written NO I

explanation.surface: A grandmother on horseback goes back over her favourite route by the waterway.
explanation.walkthrough: NO I (number one) turned round gives ION.
explanation.definitionFit: The Grand Union is the main canal linking London and Birmingham in England.

clue.text: Measure calcium needed by character in Marathon?

indicators.note: calcium is needed by the character, so its letters follow

parts.note: Marathon is in Greece, so its character is a Greek letter, pi
Ca is the chemical symbol for calcium

explanation.surface: A runner in a marathon needs to measure their calcium intake.
explanation.definitionFit: A pica is a printers' unit of type size, a sixth of an inch.

clue.text: Artist from Orleans regularly promoted play, written unconfined

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of the word Orleans
promoted means raised, so in this down answer the word reads upwards

parts.note: a game is a play or match

indicators.note: unconfined strips the bounding letters off written

explanation.surface: An artist from Orleans keeps putting on a play, scripted freely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes REN from Orleans; 'promoted' turns GAME to EMAG; 'unconfined' leaves RITTE.
explanation.definitionFit: René Magritte was the Belgian surrealist painter of the man in the bowler hat.

clue.text: Folk song that might be noticed when lying on the lawn

definitions.text: Folk song that might be noticed when lying on the lawn

parts.words: Folk song that might be noticed when lying on the lawn
parts.note: lying on grass stains the arms of your shirt the colour of the lawn

explanation.surface: A folk song you might hear while lying on the grass.
explanation.walkthrough: Lying on the lawn leaves grass stains on your arms, and that is also an old English tune.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous Tudor ballad is often said, wrongly, to have been written by Henry VIII.

clue.text: Dramatist wary to amend during difficulty

indicators.note: during puts the reworked letters within the word for difficulty

parts.note: a plight is a difficult situation

indicators.note: to amend is to alter, so the letters of wary are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A cautious writer revises a script while in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to amend' signals the anagram of 'wary'; 'during' sets it within the difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: A playwright is a writer of plays, a dramatist.

clue.text: Place for hanging car accessory, circling scorched earth

indicators.note: circling means the tyre goes around the scorched part

parts.note: a tyre is a car part
scorched means burnt

explanation.surface: A place to hang a car part, around some burnt ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'circling' has the car part go around 'scorched'; earth's E is added at the end. Tyburn was in what is now the Marble Arch area of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Tyburn Tree was the gallows at Tyburn in London, where executions were held until 1783.

clue.text: Evergreen lady in cast wearing garland

indicators.note: the garland wears the rest, meaning it is wrapped around it

parts.note: a lei is a Hawaiian garland of flowers

indicators.note: something cast is thrown or shaped, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman in the play's cast wears a floral garland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in cast' rearranges 'lady in' into YLANDI. Leylandii is the cypress hedge behind many British neighbour disputes.
explanation.definitionFit: Leylandii is a fast-growing conifer, notorious in British gardens as a hedge.

clue.text: His working week in building trade — it's dull

indicators.note: in places the first pieces inside the reworked word trade
building means being constructed, so the letters of trade are rearranged
working means the letters of his are being reworked

explanation.surface: His working week in the building trade is tedious.
explanation.walkthrough: Two anagram signals: 'working' acts on 'His' and 'building' on 'trade'. The second's letters DATER wrap the first plus W.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase 'dull as dishwater' makes the dirty washing-up water the type of dullness.

clue.text: One's content to plunge in lake. Wise man

indicators.note: plunging in means going inside, so the inner letter enters the lake

parts.note: Erie is one of the Great Lakes

indicators.note: the content of one is its inside letter

explanation.surface: A man is happy to dive into a lake, a sensible fellow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wise man' looks like a sage, but it is Ernie Wise, of the British comedy double act Morecambe and Wise.
explanation.definitionFit: Ernie Wise was the straight man of Morecambe and Wise, a famous British comedy duo.

clue.text: Second person starts to nurse Gwen's babies

parts.note: you is the second-person pronoun

indicators.note: starts to picks the first letters of nurse and Gwen's

explanation.surface: Someone else starts to look after Gwen's infants.
explanation.definitionFit: The young of an animal are its offspring, its babies.

clue.text: Partner, in fleece, showing blubber?

indicators.note: in places the partner inside the word for fleece

parts.note: to fleece a sheep is to shear it
a date is a romantic partner

explanation.surface: A partner in a woolly fleece, apparently weeping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blubber' looks like whale fat, but here it is the verb to weep.
explanation.definitionFit: To blubber is to cry noisily, so to let fall a single drop is a mild version.

clue.text: Scottish area runs ferries when organised

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

indicators.note: organised means put in order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: In a part of Scotland, a company runs ferries once properly arranged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when organised' rearranges the eleven letters of 'ferries when' to follow the R for runs.
explanation.definitionFit: Renfrewshire is a council area of west central Scotland, near Glasgow.

clue.text: Composer was forced to pen variable refrain ultimately

indicators.note: to pen is to enclose, so had holds the variable

parts.note: had, as in had to, means was forced
Y is a mathematical variable

indicators.note: ultimately picks the last letter of refrain

explanation.surface: A composer was made to write a varied chorus in the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Joseph Haydn was the Austrian classical composer known as the father of the symphony.

clue.text: See 101 locations

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning see or look
CI is 101 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Look up clue 101 for the places.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See 101' poses as a cross-reference to another clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Loci is the plural of locus, a place or position.

clue.text: Diver surfaced, missing ice mass

indicators.note: surfaced means came up, so in this down answer the letters read upward
missing means a letter is lacking from the bird

parts.note: a grebe is a diving water bird

explanation.surface: A diver came up, having lost track of the ice floe.
explanation.walkthrough: GREBE loses its last E, and GREB reads upwards. 'Diver' looks like a swimmer, but it is the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Berg is short for iceberg, a large floating mass of ice.

clue.text: Fortify network, when midsection's switched

indicators.note: switching the middle of the word swaps its two central letters around

parts.note: a grid is a network of lines

explanation.surface: Strengthen the power grid when the central part is swapped over.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle pair RI of GRID changes to IR.
explanation.definitionFit: To gird is to strengthen or fortify, as in girding yourself for a fight.

clue.text: Indoor flower, obstructing hosta, relocated by this person

indicators.note: obstructing means blocking, so the river sits inside the rearranged plant
relocated means moved, so the letters of hosta are rearranged

parts.note: a flower is something that flows, here the Scottish river Tay
this person is the setter, me

explanation.surface: An indoor plant is in the way of a hosta, so I move it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'relocated' rearranges 'hosta' to SATHO, which the river splits after its S. 'flower' is a crossword trick for a river, one that flows.
explanation.definitionFit: Stay-at-home describes someone who prefers to be indoors, rarely going out.

clue.text: Trip over snooker table somewhat

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the letters run backwards
somewhat means only part of the phrase snooker table is used

explanation.surface: A trip over the snooker table, more or less.
explanation.walkthrough: KERT sits inside 'snooker table'; 'over' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: A trek is a long, arduous journey or trip.

clue.text: Minor royal initially nipped in to cost fish

indicators.note: in puts the first letter inside the word for cost

parts.note: price means cost

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of nipped

parts.note: ling is a fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A minor royal pops in to price some fish.
explanation.walkthrough: N goes into PRICE, then add LING.
explanation.definitionFit: A princeling is a young or petty prince, a minor royal.
